decks.name: Eredin
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set witcher-realms-fall. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Eredin
hero.specialAbility:
KING OF THE WILD HUNT
While all of your Red Riders are defeated, Eredin is ENRAGED. If Eredin is ENRAGED, add +1 to the value of your combat cards, and your move value is 3.

cards.title: Backhand
cards.afterText: Your opponent puts 1 random card from their hand on top of their deck. If Eredin is ENRAGED, they discard it instead.

cards.title: Brutal Strike
cards.basicText: This card's effects cannot be canceled.
cards.duringText: If your opponent's card has an IMMEDIATELY effect, ignore their card's value.

cards.title: Close for the Kill
cards.basicText:
Draw 2 cards.
Move each of your fighters up to 3 spaces. They may move through opposing fighters.

cards.title: Foul Purpose
cards.basicText: If Eredin is ENRAGED, you may play this card face-up to target a fighter in any space.
cards.afterText: You may defeat a Red Rider to return this card to your hand.

cards.title: Icy Guile
cards.immediateText: If Eredin is ENRAGED, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.duringText: You may defeat a Red Rider to ignore the value of your opponent's card.

cards.title: Implacable
cards.basicText: If Eredin is ENRAGED, you may play this card as an attack.

cards.title: Might of the Aen Elle
cards.basicText:
Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action.
ONGOING: Eredin does not take damage except combat damage or from exhaustion.
Discard this card at the end of your turn if you didn't attack.

cards.title: Portal Defense
cards.immediateText: Eredin swaps spaces with an adjacent friendly fighter. That fighter is now the defender.
cards.afterText: If Eredin is ENRAGED, draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Skirmish
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, move one of the fighters in the combat up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: Unyielding Hordes
cards.immediateText: Return a defeated Red Rider to any space.
cards.duringText: Add +1 to this card's value for each other friendly fighter adjacent to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Wild Hunt
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter that is adjacent to at least one of your fighters. If Eredin is ENRAGED, deal 2 damage instead.

decks.name: Philippa
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set witcher-realms-fall. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Philippa
hero.specialAbility:
TWO STEPS AHEAD
At the end of your turn, you may draw until you have a hand of 4 cards.

cards.title: Backup Plan
cards.basicText: Choose one: ► set Philippa's health to 5 ► draw 3 cards

cards.title: Blinding Dust
cards.afterText: You may discard 1 card. If you do, deal damage to the opposing fighter equal to its BOOST value.

cards.title: Chain Lightning
cards.afterText: Choose a zone Philippa is in. Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in that zone.

cards.title: Cunning
cards.afterText: Your opponent may discard 1 card. If they don't, deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Do My Bidding
cards.immediateText: Return your opponent's card to their hand. Look at their hand and choose a card for them to play. (It may be the same card.)

cards.title: Lightning Bolt
cards.afterText: If you haven't taken a maneuver action this turn, deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in Philippa's zone.

cards.title: Owlform
cards.duringText: Discard any number of cards from your hand. Add +1 to this card's value for each card discarded.

cards.title: Paralyzing Fetters
cards.immediateText: The value of your opponent's card is equal to its printed value and cannot be changed.

cards.title: Polymorphy
cards.basicText:
Place Philippa in any space.
ONGOING: Philippa's move value is 5.
Discard this card at the end of your turn if Philippa is not in a zone with an opposing fighter.

cards.title: Redanian Plot
cards.immediateText: Your opponent may discard 1 card. If they don't, ignore their card's value.

cards.title: Regicide
cards.duringText: If the opposing fighter is a hero, this card's value is 6 instead.

cards.title: Spellbreaker
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: End the turn.

cards.title: Spymaster's Ruse
cards.basicText: Choose an opponent. They reveal 4 cards from their hand. Choose 2 of those cards for them to discard. Then, they draw 2 cards.

decks.name: Triss (Yennefer de compañera)
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set witcher-realms-fall. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Triss
hero.specialAbility:
MERIGOLD THE FEARLESS
At the beginning of the game, choose Yennefer or Triss to be your hero. After Triss plays a scheme, deal 2 damage to a fighter adjacent to Triss.

cards.title: Advisor to the King
cards.basicText:
Each of your fighters recovers 1 health. Draw 1 card.
ONGOING: Your BOOST values are +1.
Discard this card at the end of your turn if you didn't attack.

cards.title: Ball Lightning
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, your opponent discards 1 card. Otherwise, both players discard 1 card.

cards.title: Echoing Blast
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, return this card to your hand.

cards.title: Incinerate
cards.basicText: This card's effects cannot be canceled.
cards.duringText: Your opponent may discard 2 cards to ignore this card's value.

cards.title: Lodge of Sorceresses
cards.basicText: Each player simultaneously reveals a card from their hand and draws cards equal to their card's BOOST value. Then, the player(s) who drew the most cards deals that much damage to their hero.

cards.title: Merigold's Hailstorm
cards.afterText: Your opponent chooses one: ► they discard 2 cards ► deal 3 damage to their hero ► they discard the top 4 cards of their deck

cards.title: Paralyzing Fetters
cards.immediateText: The value of your opponent's card is equal to its printed value and cannot be changed.

cards.title: Portal to Anywhere
cards.afterText: Place a fighter in the combat in any space. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Quick and Ready
cards.afterText: Place your fighter in any space in their zone. Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Telepathy
cards.immediateText: Your opponent may discard 1 card. If they don't, cancel all effects on their card.
